PUB-001.reason: Ordinary hospitalization is covered; room, ambulance and other category limits affect payable amount.

PUB-002.reason: Claim occurs within 30-day initial waiting period without continuity evidence.

PUB-003.reason: Pre-existing disease remains inside 48-month waiting period; no prior-insurer continuity credit is supplied.

PUB-004.reason: Domiciliary condition is met because room was unavailable; aggregate domiciliary limit is 20% of Basic Sum Insured.

PUB-005.reason: Eye surgery is expressly listed for less-than-24-hour/day-care treatment and policy first-year waiting period has elapsed.

PUB-006.reason: Hospital definition/registration and medical necessity are unresolved in supplied evidence.

PUB-007.reason: Hospitalization is covered but room, professional fees, medicines/diagnostics and ambulance are subject to stated caps.

PUB-009.reason: Pre- and post-hospitalization evidence is exactly within the 30/60-day windows.

PUB-010.reason: Cataract first-year waiting period is waived after one completed year of continuous prior Indian individual health coverage and claim-history evidence is supplied.

PUB-011.reason: Facility evidence does not establish the policy definition of Hospital.
